projects.title: Projects
projects.sub: Four products I designed and built. Three are online and you can try them.

items.desc: Lead developer of the couriers' mobile app on a last-mile delivery platform at Domina Entrega Total.
Detects anomalies in electricity consumption and explains each finding with a recommended action. Deterministic engine in Go, no LLM making the call.
Mobile app and backend, built end to end. Healthcare professionals use it to look up a line of homeopathic products.
The website of a real coffee business in Marinilla. Static Next.js, fast, with its own brand.

experience.title: Chapters
experience.sub: Six years of story, from a bank apprenticeship to leading a last-mile delivery app.

bullets: Lead developer of the couriers' app (React Native, Expo, TypeScript): offline-first GPS, anti-fraud validation and real-time chat.
Designed a documents microservice and its BFF with NestJS, hexagonal architecture, DDD and CQRS.
Built an address-processing pipeline (FastAPI, Pub/Sub, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS SES) and a real-time operations chat (FastAPI, MongoDB, Keycloak, Socket.IO).
Built React micro-frontends sharing reusable components and prepared internal training on React Native and GCP.
Modules with PHP (Yii) and JavaScript on PostgreSQL and DB2.
Resolved high-level incidents on mission-critical applications.
Scalable APIs with Node.js and .NET, implementing GraphQL.
New modules and features in JavaScript and PHP, plus MySQL database administration.
